---
# HOW TO ADD A TRIP
# 1. Copy this folder and rename it, e.g. travel/2026-sikkim/
#    (folders starting with "_" are ignored, so the copy must not start with "_").
# 2. Put your photos in that folder. Resize to about 2000 px on the long side first.
# 3. Edit the fields below and the photo list.
title: "Trip title"
place: "Place, State"
date: 2026-01-15
image: cover.jpg              # the photo shown on the Travel page
image-alt: "Describe the cover photo"
description: "One or two sentences about the trip."
---
